run_count_docs: run count_docs.py on a text file to count documents, average lines, and average tokens per document
run_count_docs_gzip: run count_docs.py with --gzip flag to count documents in a gzip compressed text file
review_main: review the main function that parses args and iterates over lines to count documents separated by empty lines
summarize_gopen: summarize the gopen helper function that opens files normally or via gzip based on the --gzip flag
test_count_docs: test count_docs.py by running it on a sample file with documents separated by blank lines
